scripts.audit:api-v1: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/places.json','utf8'));if(!Array.isArray(d))throw new Error('places.json not array');const rs=['id','name','city','country','category','timeZone','createdAt','updatedAt'];const rn=['lat','lng'];const ne=v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim().length>0;const num=v=>typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v);const issues=[];for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++){const x=d[i];if(!x||typeof x!=='object'||Array.isArray(x)){issues.push({i,reason:'not_object'});continue;}for(const k of rs) if(!ne(x[k])) issues.push({i,id:x.id,name:x.name,reason:'missing_'+k});for(const k of rn) if(!num(x[k])) issues.push({i,id:x.id,name:x.name,reason:'invalid_'+k});}fs.writeFileSync('api-v1-audit.json',JSON.stringify({places:d.length,blockingIssues:issues.length,issues},null,2)+'\n');console.log('places:',d.length);console.log('blocking_issues:',issues.length);if(issues.length){console.log('see api-v1-audit.json');process.exit(2);} "
